title: Pad re-select of the already-selected junction never re-homes the diverged camera (Node_Select sets sel_node without the on_node_selected hook)
detail: After a banner nav the camera is deliberately diverged from the selection; a dpad step landing on the already-selected junction mirrors the same id onto sel_node — no hook fires and the change-diff is false, so the camera never re-targets. The W-C fold's 're-select included' contract is unreachable from the pad. Recoverable via pad-B/ESC.
recommended_fix: Fire the click=focus re-target from the Node_Select branch too: after mirroring a junction, call inp.on_node_selected (nil-safe) like click_select does at exec.odin:418.

title: Right-click re-select of the already-selected pipe bypasses the click=focus camera re-home that the left-click twin now has
evidence:
app/input/exec.odin:619-623 (right_click_select):
	if pid, ok := pipe_hit(inp.topo, inp.cat, wx, wy); ok {
		inp.sel_pipe = i64(pid)
		inp.sel_node = -1
		inp.sel_class = 0
		inp.qos_editing = false // a fresh selection starts with the editor closed

app/input/exec.odin:428-431 (the left-click twin the fold hooked):
	if pid, ok := pipe_hit(inp.topo, inp.cat, wx, wy); ok {
		inp.sel_pipe = i64(pid)
		inp.sel_node = -1
		if inp.on_pipe_selected != nil { inp.on_pipe_selected(inp.user, inp) }
detail: effect_pipe_selected now calls camera_set_selection on every left click, but right_click_select writes sel_pipe directly. Re-right-clicking the already-selected pipe after a banner nav changes nothing, so the main-loop selection-diff never fires and the camera stays at the banner target while the QoS panel refreshes.
recommended_fix: Call inp.on_pipe_selected (nil-safe) inside right_click_select's pipe branch after the state writes, mirroring click_select — or route the re-target through a shared select-pipe helper.
